gloss: many, a great number of, numerous

definitions.gloss: many, a great number of, numerous
definitions.explanation: A large number of something. Used to express that there are very many instances, items, or examples of something.

examples.japanese: {数多|かずおお}くの{作品|さくひん}を{残|のこ}した。
examples.english: He left behind a great number of works.

examples.japanese: {世界中|せかいじゅう}から{数多|かずおお}くの{観光客|かんこうきゃく}が{訪|おとず}れる。
examples.english: Numerous tourists from around the world visit.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}には{数多|かずおお}くの{種類|しゅるい}の{野鳥|やちょう}が{生息|せいそく}している。
examples.english: A great many species of wild birds inhabit this area.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used in the pattern {数多|かずおお}くの + noun (many/numerous + noun). More literary and formal than たくさん (many, a lot). Also read as あまた in a more literary register, though {数多|かずおお}く is the standard modern reading. Can function as an adverb or a noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数多|かずおお}くの: many, a great number of
- {数多|かずおお}く{存在|そんざい}する: to exist in large numbers
- {数多|かずおお}くの{経験|けいけん}: numerous experiences

SIMILAR WORDS:
- たくさん: many, a lot (general, everyday)
- {多数|たすう}: a large number (formal, quantitative)
- おびただしい: enormous, vast (even more emphatic)
